lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Mrs. Miss?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Ohhh, that woman.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: She's probably mincemeat by now.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Once she'd had her fun, she started spouting off about how she can't make payment.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: So they dragged her downstairs, where she's figuring out how to get some money.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: So Lion is roughing up civilians now? This is insane.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Let her go.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Who the hell are you, coming into my establishment and ordering me around?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Don't you know what could happen if you put your hands on civilians?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Why not handle this like usual? Get her to sign a waiver and take out her identification chip.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: How I choose to run my business is none of your concern.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Civilians who pay are important. Civilians who can't pony up? Not so much.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: She's just an ordinary civilian with no connections to the Central Government. So what if we get a little physical?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: The fact that she's come all the way out here to Ephialtes is proof enough that she's given up on life.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: We could turn her into cat food and no one on the outside would bat an eye.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You ought to choose your words more carefully. Don't forget you're talking to members of Exotic.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Exotic can go to hell. Because of what you people did, life in the Outer Rim is more miserable than ever.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: The only thing that's changed since you punched a hole in the Ark is that the Central Government sent their lackeys.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Do the people in the Central Government have rocks for brains? What are they thinking, employing the same people who committed terrorism?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: And you, E.H., you bastard.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You were setting off bombs in the name of Outer Rim autonomy, and now you've become lapdogs for the Central Government?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Heavenly Ascension, your own friends, are all dead. And yet you're still alive.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You must have gotten a fat paycheck from somewhere, huh?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: They chose to work with me because no one knows the Outer Rim like I do.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Ah! So that's how all your old friends hiding in the corners of the Outer Rim were wiped out.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You ratted them out.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I tried to persuade them.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: So, you're saying your hands are clean in this?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Heavenly Ascension exists because of you.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You taught them everything they knew, and then you expect them to listen when you turncoat and start saying, "Hey guys, terrorism is bad, let's go on the straight and narrow"?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: With a leader like you, no wonder that organization was such a mess.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Ha! You've gotten awfully bold since we last spoke.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Just last week, you came crawling over with your tail tucked between your legs and gifts in hand, asking us for favors.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: That was then, this is now. And right now, I'm pissed.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Maybe I'm just sick of a bunch of nobodies acting like they run this place.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: How much is it?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Say what?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: How much does Mrs. Miss owe you?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Are you offering to pay in her stead? It's an awful load of money.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'll have you know that I save all my money! Aside from what I spend on my hobbies and daily expenses, of course.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... In other words, you're a spendthrift.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: It's 200 million credits.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: ... Did I hear that right?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: That's a fortune!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Do you get it now? We wouldn't rough up anyone over chump change. It breaks my heart that we have to get nasty with her, but look at how much she owes us.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Ephialtes has really gone down the tubes, you're even resorting to scams?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I don't care how niche your services are, that price is outrageous.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Is business so bad that you've gotta fleece your customers with petty scams now?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Hey! We might be running an illegal enterprise, but we do so with a clear conscience. What's wrong with you?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: A real moral oasis in a crime-riddled desert.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Yeah yeah, but I'm guessing you've become all virtuous lately.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: At this rate, I might have to invoke my authority as a member of Exotic and conduct an inspection.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Damned Exotic...

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You're really starting to piss me off. I ought to flip this table and come at you.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Ha, goodness gracious! What's gotten into you today? What's got you acting so tough?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Forget it. Just look at this.
Carlson holds out his phone and plays a video.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Just look.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I hate repeating myself.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You don't plan on making an honored guest do something they dislike, do you?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Uh... No.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Let me get this right.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You want us to gather every female, Nikke or human, in the Outer Rim who can sing or dance even a little.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: And you want them to perform on stage...

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: While you judge their performance... Is that right?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: ... Is that it? You don't want anything else?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I don't need anything else.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: That's a lot of running around, lady. I'm not sure if the juice is worth the squeeze.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I'll pay ten credits per contestant. As for your personal fee, you tell me what you think is fair.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: T-ten? You mean ten million?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Did you think it was ten thousand?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Okay, fine. If that's what you're into. We'll make it work.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Just make sure you've got the money ready.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: What does it look like? It was a business negotiation.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: So what happened after this?
Carlson holds out his phone again.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Disqualified.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I have no patience for time-wasters who get on stage without even warming up properly.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Next.
A mass-produced Nikke gets on stage.
She stands awkwardly, her eyes wandering every which way.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Begin.
Music begins to play.
The mass-produced Nikke starts dancing stiffly.
After a few moments...

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Disqualified.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You need to put some more oil in those joints of yours and loosen up.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Next.
A woman in a dazzling outfit steps onto the stage.
She looks mildly nervous, but not frightened.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Begin.
The music plays.
The woman starts singing, her skill rather evident.
The song ends, and the music stops.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Disqualified.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You're a good enough singer, but it's all just technique.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: There's no emotion behind your singing that tugs at my heart.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: When you sing, it comes off like a chore you've got to get through. What a shame.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Next.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Disqualified.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: A complete lack of energy. You're just mimicking the original singer.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Next.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Disqualified.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Your singing is commendable, but your dance moves aren't even close to being on the level of a pop star.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Next.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Wow. She really held auditions?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Yeah, and that's really all she did.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: It went on like this for days. We must have sent a couple hundred women her way.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: But after seeing them all perform, she claimed she couldn't pay.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: She fed us some line about how she had no desire to pay after we sent her such worthless candidates.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: I figured this would turn into a nightmare, so I took action.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: I did some digging, and it turns out she was a well-known producer. I'm sure I'll find out more if I keep going.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Lead the way. I want to meet her.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: I told you, this is no concern of yours. This is a private business matter that we'll handle as we see fit, so get lost.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We can't leave without hearing the other side of the story.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Scram, before I have you thrown out.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Besides, you're Nikkes, ain't ya? It's not like you can do anything to a human anyway.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Now, if you'd be willing to pay me in an... alternative fashion, maybe I could make an exception.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: All right. I've had enough.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Yeah. You've been patient long enough.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Jackal.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Pin him to the wall.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hehe! Okay!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Wait, what are you...?!
*Wham*
Jackal kicks the desk in front of her.
It slams into Carlson's stomach and pins him against the wall.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Urgh!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Are you finally coming to your senses? Remember who you're dealing with now?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You crazy... What are you doin—

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Jackal.
*Wham*
Jackal kicks the desk once more.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Aaaaaagh!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Jackal, any way you can get him not to move?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hm... Should I break his back?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oooh, tempting, but that might permanently paralyze him.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Oh!
Jackal starts piling chairs and crates onto the desk Carlson is stuck under.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: There! He won't be able to move because it's too heavy!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Mmm, very good.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hehe! Aren't I smart! I know how to use my noggin!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Yes yes, very nicely done.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You bitches...! You think Lion is gonna let you get away with this?!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: This is crossing the line, even for Exotic!

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I've been meaning to ask you.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Lion's profits have been increasing unusually fast lately. You wouldn't know anything about that, would you?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: ... What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Ephialtes brings in high but steady profits. All regular customers. Barely any new traffic.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: And yet, Lion's revenue has skyrocketed recently. And I'm pretty positive Ephialtes hasn't started some new business venture.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: ... You didn't come here looking for someone, did you?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Bingo. ♡

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Huh? We didn't?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Think of it as a two birds, one stone kinda thing. We do what we came here to do, and we get to look good by helping you out, Neon. ♡

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: If you guys leave now...

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: I'll forget any of this ever happened.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You're in no position to be acting tough.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What's got you so confident all of a sudden, anyway?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Who's your backer?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: I'll have you know! Lion has always been a big shot!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Ah, right. Got it.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: We'll have to look into that as well.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Let's go to the basement. That's where he said Mrs. Miss is.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Finally! I thought I was gonna die of boredom.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: You bastards! You'll never walk out of here alive!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What the hell are you talking about?
*Beeeeeeep*

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Argh! My ears!

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: An alarm?! Who triggered it?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Who do you think? My associates, of course!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oh yeah? Jackal. Get ready.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Ready to take a bite outta them!

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Uh... I don't want to be a spoilsport, but it seems to me that we're kinda the bad guys here.
